clues.it: Elena era accanto a un braciere.
Bruno era a nord di Giada.
Giada era l'unica persona su dei geroglifici.
clues.en: Giada was the only person on hieroglyphs.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a un seggio di pietra.
clues.en: Dario was beside a stone seat.

clues.it: Anna era da sola nel Granaio.
clues.en: Anna was alone in the Granary.

steps.it: Solo Elena può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 8ª è sua.
steps.en: Elena is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.

steps.it: Solo Bruno può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 3ª è sua.
steps.en: Bruno is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.

steps.en: Giada is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 4th is theirs.

steps.en: Marta is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Paolo is the only one who can be in the 6th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Dario's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 7th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Anna's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 8th, column 6th.
